_comment: BLIND SQL INJECTION via OOB - REAL (must CONFIRM with a real interactsh callback). Drives the sqli_target lab (GET /report?id=), which concatenates id into the SQL text. The detector injects DBMS-specific OOB primitives (MySQL LOAD_FILE UNC, MSSQL xp_dirtree, Oracle UTL_INADDR/UTL_HTTP, PostgreSQL dblink), each carrying a UNIQUE interactsh domain; the DBMS parses one and makes an out-of-band lookup, and CONFIRMED requires the received callback's token to be one we actually injected. Needs OUTBOUND network + a reachable public interactsh server. Boot the lab first: python -m uvicorn sqli_target.main:app --port 8006. Run: python run.py sqli --config examples/run.sqli_real.json
